title: Porsche Newsroom US: Porsche owners can now access the Tesla Supercharger network (2025-09-05)
notes: MY2026 Taycan and Macan Electric include the Porsche NACS DC adapter at no additional fee; MY2025 Taycan owners and all existing Macan Electric owners eligible for a complimentary adapter (My Porsche app notice to reserve); MY2024 and older Taycan owners can purchase it, MSRP US$185, Porsche Online Shop or Porsche Centers from 2025-09-05.
